objs.name: document
objs.description: Core managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other controlled content subject to lifecycle management.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (1-4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation prefix used in the document name (e.g. RL).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client 4-digit sequential number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, computed from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable duration for validity checks (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period after invalidation (default 10 years).

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original Office format of the document content (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity the document applies to.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: Client(s) in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document that is versioned and released together with its main document; creation, modification or archiving triggers a new main document version.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary non-controlled document content (e.g. photos, screenshots, brief instructions) not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the additional info is published.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal request to amend a released document, created by any author-rights holder without affecting the document version until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. Created, Scheduled, Completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated request triggered 30 days before document validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate a released document and archive it, triggering the out-of-force process.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated (archived) document, restricted to Business Admin group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person who participates in document lifecycle processes in various roles.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role(s) assigned to the user (Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Named group of users used to assign read/change authorizations and distribution memberships.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Purpose of the group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Distribution).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Configuration of user groups and persons to be notified or required to acknowledge upon document release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process instance that orchestrates approval steps (Creator, Review, Release) with electronic signatures.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Translation Release, Acknowledgement).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the workflow instance.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Recorded digital signature of a workflow participant confirming completion of a workflow step.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Identity of the person who signed.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was applied.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step the signature corresponds to (Creator, Review, Release).

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents, supporting TAG technology for metadata insertion.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Office format of the template (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational entity (department, location) to which documents or processes can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Business process that can be linked to documents for process-specific filing and management.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is attached in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The document content is opened and modified using the integrated editing client in local Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of the document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the system automatically converts the document to PDF for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author completes the Creator step of the release workflow with an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness and completes the review step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for publication and completes the release step with electronic signature.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the approval workflow, canceling remaining steps.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, or attachment modifications.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is edited, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: A non-controlled supplementary information object is added to a document.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: A non-critical additional information object is removed from a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author-rights holder creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is planned for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the resolution of a change proposal; the proposal creator is notified.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically generates a validity extension request 30 days before document expiry.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Releaser (and optionally author/reviewer) processes the validity extension request via workflow.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document validity is confirmed and the Valid Until date is updated by the default period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: Releaser (and optionally initiator/reviewer) processes the override request via workflow.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is invalidated, all rights except archive group are revoked, and archiving begins.

evts.name: delete_archived_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the document is physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator processes the reactivation workflow step, confirming reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is restored with a new version, original metadata, authorizations, and attachments.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are added to or removed from a document's distribution list.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Upon release, users on the email distribution list receive an email notification about the new version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, users on the acknowledgement distribution list are requested to confirm acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator creates a language-dependent version of a released document's content.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated document version is checked and released via a dedicated approval workflow.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: An external file is uploaded to an existing document object cover.

evts.name: generate_office_document
evts.description: A new document is generated from standard MS Office formats within an object cover.
